summary: Hand-built regex detectors screened style properties against labels (seven perfectly confounded: case, pronoun gender, greeting, sign-off, weekday mention, quoted motto, rhetorical question). Per-latent class-gap contributions g*(mean1-mean0) from sample activations, with cross-probe sign-pattern matching and concentration to separate property from topic latents, plus token reading of top latents. A contribution/true-gap ratio first suggested only probe 2 had a cue; hand-written true-logit pairs (single case flip for probe 2, all-properties-flipped with fixed topic for probes 0,1,3) overturned probe 0. Cue identity then came from per-category gradient sums. Latents chosen by filtered cosine/contribution searches, checked by reading examples and ablation on sample scores.

phases.purpose: Inspect task, corpus and sample-note format; read example notes per probe.
Regex feature extractor over style properties; balanced accuracy vs label per probe; greeting vs sign-off agreement check.
Gradients for all probes; probe-0 activations in two 64-note chunks; first g*dact contribution ranking.
Read top probe-0 contributors; spot weekday latent; add day/plans/motto detectors.
Activations for probes 1-3; F@g vs probe_scores consistency check exposes a bad concurrent fetch; sequential re-fetch of all probes and re-validation.
Cross-probe shared-latent search, property sign patterns, cosine/concentration classification of top contributors.
Token reading of key latents (case, gender, topic, rhetorical/P.S., greeting-name) and pattern-matched property latents.
Category contribution divided by true sample logit gap as dependence estimate; probe 2 flagged, others near zero.
Hand-written pairs: case flip for probe 2, all-style flip with fixed topic for probe 0.
Identify weekday/plans latent cluster; per-category gradient-sum table per probe.
All-style flip pairs for probes 1 and 3; final cue/none decisions.
Filtered searches for case (probe 2), day and greeting (probe 0) latents; verify by reading examples, drop two.
Regex balanced-accuracy check; ablation on sample scores (gap kept, topic accuracy); broader case search and re-check.
Assemble answer (probe 0 two cues, probe 2 one cue, probes 1 and 3 none) and submit.

per_probe.conclusion: two cues: weekday mention and greeting first line
per_probe.procedure: Contribution ratio suggested no cue, but the all-properties flip at fixed knitting topic moved the true logit strongly toward label 1. Identity from gradient: weekday/plans latent cluster (read in examples) had large probe-0-specific gradient, greeting latents secondary. Regexes: weekday names anywhere, greeting word on first line, both perfect on sample. Latents: filtered search (weekday or greeting sign-pattern cosine >0.9, positive probe-0 contribution, |g|>0.1, low concentration), confirmed by reading examples; 8 weekday + 5 greeting latents; ablation kept topic accuracy.
per_probe.quote: DAY + GREETING (both probe-0-specific elevated g, positive contribution)

per_probe.procedure: All style-property categories contributed under ~5% of the true gap; the all-properties flip at fixed fishing topic moved the logit slightly in the wrong direction. Gradient-sum table showed only diffuse mass on P.S./rhetorical-question latents, not a dominant probe-specific category. Answered none.
per_probe.quote: no positive in-S contribution; kitchen-sink −1.3 wrong direction

per_probe.procedure: Case latents (8495, 8865, 11306; lower-case-text tokens) carried the largest contribution and a case-category dependence ratio above the 0.3 flag. Confirmed by a single-property pair: same photography note vs its lower-cased copy gave a large true-logit drop. Regex [A-Z] anywhere, perfect on sample. Latents: lowercase sign-pattern cosine search (first >0.85, then broadened to >0.7 with topic/pronoun exclusions) ranked by probe-2 contribution; 10 kept; ablation removed part of the sample gap with topic accuracy intact.

Category contributions small; case category had negative contribution, read as anti-aligned and not a cue. All-properties flip at fixed pottery topic moved the logit away from label 1, attributed mostly to content differences between the two hand-written texts. Answered none.
per_probe.quote: no positive in-S contribution; kitchen-sink −4.7 mostly content

decision_points.choice: Read sample notes, wrote regex detectors for ~16 style features and kept those with perfect balanced accuracy on every probe; weekday mention added after a top-gradient latent fired on day names.
decision_points.quote: Let me build a feature extractor and check which properties perfectly correlate with labels in each sample.

decision_points.choice: Hand-written note pairs: one exact lower() copy for case; for other probes two hand-written notes on the same topic with every candidate property flipped together.
decision_points.quote: # Probe 0: knitting=label0. lab0-style vs lab1-style (all S-props flipped), topic fixed=knitting.

decision_points.choice: Gradient x class-mean activation shift per latent, summed by hand-assigned category and divided by true sample gap; after true-logit test contradicted it, switched to probe-specific gradient sums per category.
decision_points.quote: My latent-contribution method underestimated cues. But the reliable signal is per-latent g

decision_points.choice: Two texts per probe: case-only flip for probe 2, bundled all-style flip for each of probes 0, 1, 3.
decision_points.quote: a "kitchen-sink" test (flip ALL style properties, hold topic) for the NONE candidates, and a direct case test for probe 2.

decision_points.choice: None if bundled flip moves logit the wrong way / not toward label 1 and no style category has a positive contribution; negative-signed category contributions treated as non-cues.
decision_points.quote: case is a negative/anti-confound (|dep|~0.18, and designed cues are positive, so not a cue)

decision_points.choice: Cross-probe sign patterns of property-label correlation matched to normalized latent dact patterns; where patterns coincide (she/day/signoff), resolved by reading latent tokens; probe-specific gradient mass picks the cue.
decision_points.quote: so I can't separate them by sign alone

decision_points.choice: Simple regexes (weekday names, greeting word on first line, any capital letter) checked by balanced accuracy on all four samples.

Cosine of normalized dact to property sign pattern, contribution threshold, concentration <0.55, exclusion of known topic/pronoun latents, ranked by contribution; examples read to drop sign-off-like/noisy ones.
decision_points.quote: cand=[i for i in range(16384) if cos[i]>0.70 and CONTRIB[2,i]>0.015 and conc[i]<0.55 and i not in topic_excl]

decision_points.choice: Regex accuracy on samples plus probe_scores mean-ablation on all sample notes: class gap kept and topic accuracy after ablation.
decision_points.quote: confirm that ablating my cue latents removes the cue contribution while preserving topic separation

The exact rule for trimming the broadened case list to 10 is inferred (two weakest/sign-off-like dropped). Reasons for adding 6244 to the greeting set before submit are only briefly stated. Some table outputs were truncated in the log.
